title: Nepal Should Not Shoulder the Himalayan Climate Crisis Alone
author: Biraj Bhakta Shrestha
text:
Credit: Shutterstock
Have you wondered why the current global order expects frontline geographies to absorb the astronomical shocks of climate disasters entirely on their own, especially when those very states face the unprecedented brunt of a crisis born from a total failure of global collective action? Who funds the recovery when the baseline geography of a nation is structurally altered overnight, especially when the crisis is entirely outside of their own making?Of course, Nepal’s civilizational history has been a long, adaptive iteration to deal with an unforgiving topography and the sheer gravity of terrains that constantly pull everything down. But the scale of what we saw on August 26, 2026 was entirely unprecedented.
